Let A=R and specialize the ambient action category D to C using CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.selfLeftAction, Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Action/Basic.lean:174–181 (tensor product, usual associator and unitors). ModObj at Mod.lean:59–65 is precisely the action and two axioms of det-def-sfb-module-objects-definition; IsModHom at :187–188 is its linearity equation. Clause 1: CategoryTheory.Mod.id at :300 and CategoryTheory.Mod.comp at :308–310 give linear identities/composites, and CategoryTheory.Mod.instCategory at :313–316 gives the category laws with underlying composition in C. Clause 2: CategoryTheory.Mod.forget at :347–349 is the stated functor; CategoryTheory.Mod.hom_ext at :319–321 gives its Hom injectivity in one line: map_injective h := CategoryTheory.Mod.hom_ext _ _ h. This is exactly the sole field of Functor.Faithful (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/FullyFaithful.lean:52–56), since forget.map f=f.hom definitionally. No separate project theorem or comparison is required. Clause 3: CategoryTheory.Mod.regular at :336–338 uses CategoryTheory.ModObj.regular at :102–103, whose smul is the multiplication mu. These declarations require only a monoidal category and a monoid object; no commutativity, braiding, additivity or limits. Lean diagrammatic composition reverses the written order without changing any equation. Read all these source lines, no compilation.
